## Checklist

- [ ] Lowercase `airports/<icao>.json` filename with matching uppercase ICAO identifier.
- [ ] WGS84 decimal degrees and maximum wingspan in metres.
- [ ] Code letters and ICAO aircraft type designators are not confused.
- [ ] Unknown restrictions stay null; any allowlist is explicitly exhaustive.
- [ ] Stands reference correct sources and conditions are explained.
- [ ] Accurate dates; imports are not marked reviewed without original-source checks.
- [ ] I may redistribute this contribution under the repository license; no charts/PDFs attached.
- [ ] Local validation or the PR validation result passes.
